_comment: The beach's harvest-mob, the Turnip copied field for field: role structure + speed 0, no skills, no faction, no aggroRadius, and the wildcard resistance blocks every damage tag except 'harvest', so only Harvest pops it. xpFactor 0.05 = the Turnip's one token. ⭐ Heaps of washed-up kelp along the tide line of Saltgrass Strand (the beach north of the Farmlands) for the Miller's `the-millers-ring`: each one harvested while that quest's search stage is running rolls a 6 % chance of finding the ring, and the 12th always does. ⚑ THE BEACH IS THE SPECIES: the quest counts this definition, never a position, so placing Seaweed anywhere else makes that spot a ring beach too. ⛑ Its own entityType Seaweed with placeholder art (seaweed.svg); earns its own sprite at the Zone 1 art pass. All values [PLACEHOLDER].
